firmware 1.10.0.bin.description: [v1.10.0] [New feat] telemetry reports the STA signal strength (RSSI) so the Web UI header and the NINA plugin grade the signal bars from the real value. [Fix] a soft STOP now ramps both axes down with the configured deceleration instead of stopping the axis dead (the far target was cancelled at once), with a 2.5 s safety net. [UI] AP icon colour tuned; the release export reads its version from src/main.cpp.
